icarus_developer_connected.subject: ICARUS is connected — build with memory
icarus_developer_connected.preheader: Your developer identity is ready. No HIVEMIND workspace or plan was created.
icarus_developer_connected.text:
Hi {{name}},

ICARUS is connected to your HIVEMIND developer identity. This is developer mode: no HIVEMIND workspace, personal plan, or enterprise account was created.

Start with local durable memory:
- Save decisions, invariants, root causes, and verified patches.
- Recall only the context needed for the current task.
- Keep lexical recall available even without an embedding provider.

Docs: {{appUrl}}/research/icarus

Best of luck building.
The SINGULANCE team
